mapper.sql: line_id, taking_id, material_stock_id, item_id, item_code, item_name, specification, unit_of_measure, unit_name, batch_id, batch_code, quantity, taking_quantity, diff_quantity, warehouse_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, location_id, location_code, location_name, area_id, area_code, area_name, taking_status, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select from wm_stock_taking_line where taking_id = #{takingId} and del_flag = '0' order by item_code, location_code
select from wm_stock_taking_line where line_id = #{lineId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from wm_stock_taking_line where taking_id = #{takingId} and del_flag = '0' and taking_status = 'PREPARE'

mapper.insert: insert into wm_stock_taking_line (taking_id, material_stock_id, item_id, item_code, item_name, specification, unit_of_measure, unit_name, batch_id, batch_code, quantity, warehouse_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, location_id, location_code, location_name, area_id, area_code, area_name, taking_status, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{takingId}, #{materialStockId}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{specification}, #{unitOfMeasure}, #{unitName}, #{batchId}, #{batchCode}, #{quantity}, #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, #{locationId}, #{locationCode}, #{locationName}, #{areaId}, #{areaCode}, #{areaName}, 'PREPARE', '0', #{remark}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.update: update wm_stock_taking_line set taking_quantity = #{takingQuantity}, diff_quantity = #{diffQuantity}, taking_status = 'CONFIRMED', update_time = now() where line_id = #{lineId} and del_flag = '0' and taking_status = 'PREPARE'
